column1: # Production's coverage windows for src/window_coverage/production_parity.rs, one row per generated
# stream: every window in emission order, reduced to its count and an FNV-1a digest over each
# window's contig (u32), centre (u32), mean depth and GC fraction (each f32 as its bit pattern), all
# little-endian. The full stream is 447,581 windows, too large to commit window by window.
# First frozen at promotion plan step C13 from production's
# sample_summary::coverage::SlidingWindowCoverageAccumulator at commit d9e7b076, on streams drawing
# depths 0 to 39. Re-recorded 2026-10-08 on the same streams with depths 1 to 39, when ng stopped
# counting a base at depth 0 as covered: production counted it, so the two no longer agree there.
# Production being deleted, the rows were written by `record_the_stream_digests` from ng's
# accumulator at main 9ee6c536 — the one the first recording proved equal to production's on every
# stream — with the generator changed and nothing else.
# Columns, tab-separated: seed, window width in bases, windows emitted, digest.
